# Voice Assist AI Project

## Project Overview
A Voice Assist AI application built with Java and Spring Boot that provides:
- Real-time speech recognition
- Natural language processing
- Voice response synthesis
- WebSocket-based real-time communication

## Technology Stack
- Java 21 (LTS)
- Spring Boot 3.2+
- Maven for build management
- WebSocket for real-time communication
- TensorFlow Lite for ML (optional)

## Development Guidelines
- Follow Spring Boot best practices
- Use WebSocket for real-time voice communication
- Implement proper error handling for speech APIs
- Include logging for audio processing
